redcap:Surveys.title: Main survey
redcap:Surveys.instructions:
[lphu_name_ip1] is contacting people who were at [ip_name_ip1], where avian influenza (bird flu) has been found in poultry. The chance of people catching bird flu is low, but people who have been near infected birds or their droppings, feathers or eggs may be at higher risk of getting bird flu.

This survey should take 5 minutes or less. It checks if you were at [ip_name_ip1] and have been exposed to bird flu. It explains what you should do if you become unwell.

Privacy: [lphu_name_ip1] is collecting this information to respond to an outbreak of avian influenza in poultry. We may share it with the Department of Health and Agriculture Victoria for the outbreak investigation. Information provided will not be shared with your employer or anybody else. If you do not provide this information, we may not be able to assess your risk or give you the right advice. You can ask to see the information you provide by contacting [lphu_number_ip1].

Question.TranslatedText: I am calling from [lphu_name_ip1]. We are working with the Department of Health and the Department of Agriculture in Victoria. Privacy statement: [lphu_name_ip1] is committed to protecting your privacy. [lphu_name_ip1] is collecting this health information in response to an outbreak of avian influenza. To facilitate the outbreak investigation, we may share your health information with Department of Health or Agriculture Victoria. If you do not provide us with the information requested, we will not be able to investigate your possible exposure to avian influenza. You may access the information you provide to [lphu_name_ip1]. As you may be aware, we have been notified of an avian influenza ("bird flu") virus outbreak among chickens at [ip_name_ip1]. We are calling because you have been identified as potentially having been exposed to this virus. The chance of humans becoming infected with bird flu virus is low. However, people who come into contact with infected birds or contaminated bird products as part of their daily work or activities may be at risk of becoming infected. We are calling to get some more information from you and give you advice on what you need to do.
